dims.what: Game rules: only outcomes, requirements, items, units, captains and numbers in the facts; nothing the game can't do
dims.reason: Every outcome, selector, requirement and captain exists, and every number is inside the guardrails: gold up to +140, crew down to -45, ship down to -50 and up to +60, XP 40. Events cannot kill (health floors at 1), so lines like "nobody dies today" are safe. The Kraken is only hinted at, never fought (S06). The choices also use the game's own pieces: "Two shots below the waterline" matches the ship's two cannons, and "nothing but your sword" matches the Conqueror being sword-only (C03). The weakest link is small: "the blast still throws burning timber across your deck" leans on an exploding enemy ship, which only exists in events. It is still plausible.

dims.what: Text matches data: every body, label and result is true to the outcomes of its choice, in every RandomOf branch (V07)
dims.reason: Most result lines match their outcomes (V07). The Burning Cutter RandomOf uses one result for both branches, "carrying whatever they could grab before the powder went", and it reads true either way. "nobody else bleeds for it" matches the Captain-only selector. "The hull stays whole" matches a choice with no ShipHealth outcome. The weakest line is the Burning Cutter helm result, "Only the paint on your stern blisters.": it says the damage is cosmetic, but the choice takes ShipHealth -20. Also, "How much that is depends on how long they dared stay" explains the gamble instead of showing it.

dims.what: Real decisions with sink-or-plunder tension (S02), ship vs crew costs (S03), Good/Bad fit (S07), fair for a medium ~30 minute run, no dominant or trap choice
dims.reason: S02 is restaged well. Brigantine is sink for 75 against board for 140 at -25 to all crew, close to the game's 1x vs 1.5x. Wreck Current is a clean hull-or-crew split (S03). The Bad events always offer a way to limit the damage (S07). But two gated choices are strictly dominant, which the author admits. Brigantine "Run up your colours" gives +140 for nothing, so a Fearmongerer has no decision at all: sinking (75) and boarding (140 for -25 crew) are both beaten. Galleon "Go over alone" is the crates choice with the cost moved onto the captain only, so it beats "Take their crates". The shipped captain perks that carry stakes still risk something (the beard RandomOf in Wreckers Among the Hulls). Burning Cutter's two ship-only choices are nearly the same call: "Sink her at range" (-30 ship, +30 gold) against "Put the helm over" (-20 ship). That's 10 HP for 30 gold, which is no real decision.

dims.what: Sounds like the voice rules (V01-V07), the reference lines and the shipped pool; Ship's Log aesthetic (A01-A03)
dims.reason: The dry understatement is on target (V03): "What floats up is yours: one strongbox and a great many splinters." and "the pumps are working harder than anyone aboard." Bodies are 3 sentences and results 1-2 (V06), with no stage-pirate words (V04) and imperative labels (V05). The batch repeats itself, though. "Two shots ... she goes down" closes both sink choices (Brigantine, Cutter). "long curved line" and "long curved bite" both carry the Kraken hint (Galleon, Cutter). "cuts" lands in two results ("the list of cuts to stitch", "a lot of cuts"). Some phrases are awkward: "something with a grip" and "snag a purse off a dead rail". The weakest line is "How much that is depends on how long they dared stay.", which reads like a rules note, not a log entry (A01).

dims.what: Stranger test: could a stranger tell this is Deadwater Run? Low if the event would work unchanged in any other pirate game (S01-S08, C01-C03)
dims.reason: The Brigantine is very Deadwater Run. It offers exactly the Fearmongerer's third choice from the GDD (sink, kill, or scare them into giving up) and ties surrender to "They know the flag" (Dread Reputation, C02). Wreck Current asks which of the two health bars pays (S03), and the Team Leader shields the crew (C01). Galleon's Conqueror is "stronger than his crew" (C03). Every hull is a rival crew's ship broken by something from below (S06, S08). The rest is weaker. With the names swapped, Wreck Current's boathooks scene and Galleon's scavengers-stripping-a-wreck scene would work in most pirate games, and Galleon retreads the shipped Wreckers Among the Hulls. The Burning Cutter has no captain hook. Three of the four events are "a broken ship drifts by", so the brief's "sea that is getting worse" only shows up once.

findings.problem: "Run up your colours" gives Gold +140 with no cost. A Fearmongerer gets the same gold as "Board her and clear the deck" without the -25 crew damage, and much more than "Put her under" (75). So the event offers no decision for that captain.
findings.fix: Keep the surrender but add stakes. Either cut the gold to 100-110, or make it a RandomOf where a holdout at the rail sometimes costs CrewHealth -15 Random. If you use the RandomOf, write the result so it reads true either way.
